OmniDataTransformItem.FormulaExpression: IF(OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(%BLAccount:CategoryL1__c%)), %BLAccount:CategoryL1__c% == 'Mobile type A'), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(%BLAccount:CategoryL2__c%)), OR(%BLAccount:CategoryL2__c% == 'Mobile type B', %BLAccount:CategoryL2__c% == 'Mobile type C'))), true, false)

OmniDataTransformItem.FormulaExpression: CONCAT(IF(%ExemptionBLA:SystemExemptUnderDWPRSection31__c% == true, 'System exempt under DWPR Section 3.1', ''), IF(%ExemptionBLA:PointOfEntry__c% == true, IF(%ExemptionBLA:SystemExemptUnderDWPRSection31__c% == true, ', Point-of-Entry', 'Point-of-Entry'), ''), IF(%ExemptionBLA:NonPotable__c% == true, IF(OR(%ExemptionBLA:SystemExemptUnderDWPRSection31__c% == true, %ExemptionBLA:PointOfEntry__c% == true), ', Non-Potable', 'Non-Potable'), ''), IF(%ExemptionBLA:PointOfUse__c% == true, IF(OR(%ExemptionBLA:SystemExemptUnderDWPRSection31__c% == true, OR(%ExemptionBLA:PointOfEntry__c% == true, %ExemptionBLA:NonPotable__c% == true)), ', Point-of-Use', 'Point-of-Use'), ''))
OmniDataTransformItem.Name: PHOCSExtractGetWSEPermitTemplate

OmniDataTransformItem.FormulaExpression: IF(AND(%BLAccount:CategoryL1__c% == 'Groundwater', %BLADataWSE:GARPScreeningOutcome__c% != 'GARP - Low Risk of Pathogens'), true, false)
